cards.name: Fire
cards.detail: Bullets ignite enemies, dealing damage over time.

cards.name: Pierce
cards.detail: Bullets pass through the first enemy they hit.

cards.name: Chain
cards.detail: Hits arc lightning to a nearby enemy.

cards.name: Explosive
cards.detail: Bullets explode on impact for small area damage.

explosive|pierce.name: Breach Round
explosive|pierce.effect: Each enemy pierced triggers a smaller explosion.

chain|ricochet.name: Arc Bounce
chain|ricochet.effect: Each ricochet also chains lightning to one target.
chain|ricochet.notes: Might be too strong in corridors.

fire|lifesteal.name: Cauterize
fire|lifesteal.effect: Burn damage heals you at half rate.

rapid|slow.effect: They cancel out; no interesting choice.
rapid|slow.notes: Revisit if Slow becomes a freeze.

lifesteal|rapid.effect: Just a bigger number, no new play.
